faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Prasar Bharati Correspondent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Prasar Bharati Correspondent recruitment is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Correspondent post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Correspondent post in Prasar Bharati.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Correspondent role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree/PG Diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication/relevant field and proficiency in Hindi and Punjabi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Correspondent position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Correspondent position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Correspondent post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Correspondent post ranges from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Prasar Bharati Correspondent recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Correspondent post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Correspondent position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Correspondent position is contract-based.
